spr_002: You can recognise it by the torii and straw rope around its trunk, with heavy roots breaking the surface. It stands in the car park at the entrance to Koganeyu Onsen.
spr_003: You can recognise it as the biggest tree in the park, its top lost so it stands shorter than it once did. It stands near the Minami 14-jo bridge, at the southern end of Nakajima Park.
spr_004: You can recognise it by its huge leaves, turning brown and staying on through winter instead of falling. It stands on the path between the third torii and the worship hall at Hokkaido Shrine.
spr_005: You can recognise it by its narrow, oddly pruned outline, its limbs cut back from the road. It stands between the carriageway and pavement beside Sapporo Gokoku Shrine.
